name: Own 3D mode
summary: The game renders 3D itself and outputs it in a format such as side-by-side. Nothing is installed; you switch it on in the game (or its config file). On Simulated Reality displays, Stereo Loom turns the side-by-side picture into glasses-free 3D.
compatibility_notes: Which formats a game outputs comes from PCGamingWiki's list of games with native 3D.
